name: Autoreject
notes: Autoreject: 1-40 Hz band-pass, then local autoreject on 1 s epochs (10-fold cross-validation of the per-channel thresholds, of rho and of kappa): bad channels interpolated within their epoch, epochs with too many bad channels removed
nothing else belongs to it: the example removes no line noise (the 40 Hz low-pass takes care of it), does not resample, does not reference, and leaves the bad channels to autoreject
eye artefacts are not covered either; add the ICA step before Interpolation periods when they matter
check: Lookup: the montage of your system, and whether a reference channel is added
Open: how your files are read
